title: WuYuEval：面向固体废物管理的大语言模型多层级基准测试
summary: WuYuEval是一个用于评估大语言模型在固体废物管理领域能力的多层级基准，包含4590道基础选择题和247道专家级开放题，覆盖知识、推理和决策三个层次。测试33个模型发现性能差异大，推理模式并非总是有效，为开发专业模型提供了依据。
summary_en: WuYuEval is a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in solid waste management, with 4,590 basic MCQs and 247 expert open-ended questions. Testing 33 models shows wide performance gaps and that reasoning modes are not always beneficial, providing a basis for developing specialized models.
